area: Printer Friendly Work Orders - Print Summary and Footer
title: Summary shows total actual and estimated time
permissions_required: View Work Order (no new permission introduced)
preconditions: You have triggered Print Work Order from the work order detail view (print view rendered).
The work order has at least one line item.
steps: Read the summary section that appears after all line items.
expected:
1. A summary section appears after all line items, displaying total actual time / total estimated time across all lines.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9383 and story SV-9387 (Story 4, Print Layout - Summary and Footer) and the Printer Friendly Work Orders specification version 8, section S4-R1, read on 25 August 2026.
